# Contributing to Breakout (Rust + Macroquad)

Thank you for contributing! This guide outlines how to contribute effectively.

1. Fork and clone the repository. Create a feature branch for your work.
2. Run rustfmt and cargo clippy (if available) to keep the code clean.
3. Build and test locally: cargo build --release and run the game.
4. Add or update tests if relevant. Ensure existing tests pass.
5. Submit a pull request with a descriptive title and a PR description referencing the issue.

Code style and guidelines:
- Follow Rust formatting (rustfmt) and naming conventions used in this repo.
- Add comments where necessary for complex logic.
- Keep PRs small and focused on a single feature or bug.

This repo is a learning/experimental project; contributions are welcome but please discuss design decisions in the PR description.
